text.name: Pachirisu

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Self-Generation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Pachirisu from your hand onto your Bench, you may attach up to 2 {Lightning} Energy cards from your hand to Pachirisu.

attacks.name: Shocking Bolt
attacks.text: Put all Energy cards attached to Pachirisu in the Lost Zone.

text.flavor: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It absorbs charges from the air.

text.name: Cleffa

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

text.name: Tyrogue

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Tyrogue is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Tyrogue by attacks.

attacks.name: Mischievous Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Tyrogue is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will keep going without resting.

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: The MAGNEMITE are united by a magnetism so powerful, it drives all matter in its vicinity.

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Magnetic Switch
attacks.text: Switch Magnemite with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: The units in the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

text.name: Copycat
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Judge
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) (If you choose a Stage 2 Pokémon in your hand, put that Pokémon on the Basic Pokémon instead of on a Stage 1 Pokémon.)

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Free Flight
abilities.text: If Yanma has no Energy attached to it, Yanma's Retreat Cost is 0.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Spray Splash
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This power can't be used if Kingdra is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dragon Steam
attacks.text: If your opponent has any {Fire} Pokémon in play, this attack's base damage is 20 instead of 60.

text.name: Junk Arm
effect: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. You can't choose Junk Arm with the effect of this card.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Magnetic Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. This power can't be used if Magnezone is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Lost Burn
attacks.text: Put as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like in the Lost Zone. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards put in the Lost Zone in this way.

text.name: Pokémon Collector
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Insight
abilities.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, the attack cost of each of Yanmega's attacks is 0.

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.name: Pokémon Communication
effect: Reveal a Pokémon in your hand and put it on top of your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Pokémon Reversal
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.name: Professor Oak's New Theory
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
